newsitem.title: MEXICO: ICA wins $23.8 mln Puerto Rico road contract.
newsitem.headline: ICA wins $23.8 mln Puerto Rico road contract.

text.p: Mexican construction firm Empresas ICA Sociedad Controladora SA de CV announced on Monday that it has won a $23.8 million road contract in Puerto Rico.
ICA said it and a Puerto Rican company were granted the contract by the municipal government of Guaynabo on February 21.

"The contract will reach $23.8 million and will be executed by ICA Miramar Corp, formed between ICA (51 percent) and the Puerto Rican firm Miramar Construction Corp (49 percent), and will be paid for by the municipal government," ICA said in a news release.
The project, expected to last 35 months, encompasses the construction of 3.63 miles (5.85 km) of highway, including two bridges of 1,313 and 218 feet (398 and 66 meters).
